summary: The note describes the Yale Review of Law and Social Action, a student-edited quarterly published by Yale University from 1970 to 1973. It notes that Hillary Rodham served on its Board of Editors and was an associate editor while attending Yale Law School.
one_line: A student-edited Yale University quarterly on law and social action, published 1970 to 1973, with Hillary Rodham as an associate editor.
